description.value: A community-led museum on Cortes Island exploring the social, cultural, and natural history of the island and surrounding region. It also houses Destination BC's Visitor Information booth with free maps, guides, and brochures—some available on a covered porch even outside staffed hours. Admission is free, and touring cyclists will find an e-bike charging station on site.

address.value: 957 Beasley Rd, Mansons Landing, BC V0P 1K0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Cortes Island Museum & Archives Society, a community museum on Cortes Island that also houses Destination BC's Visitor Information booth. The tourist information subpage explicitly states 'An e-bike charging station is available by donation,' confirming that amenity. No evidence was found for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other amenities. OSM has no address or phone; the website provides both (957 Beasley Rd, 250-935-6340). The OSM name 'Museum & Archives' is notably generic compared to the website's full name.
